children: Vecima Networks Inc. (TSX: VCM) today announced it will showcase a broad next-generation access portfolio at SCTE TechExpo 2026, taking place September 29 – October 1 in Atlanta, Georgia. Led by the launch of Entra® Intelligence, Vecima’s new AI-powered operational awareness platform for cable and fiber access networks, the showcase will feature live demonstrations spanning 50G-PON migration, DOCSIS® 4.0 deployments, simplified network operations, and new broadband and video service opportunities.

The demonstrations are designed to show practical ways operators can evolve cable and fiber networks for higher capacity, greater automation, and more flexible service delivery. Across 50G-PON migration, DOCSIS 4.0 readiness, unified PON management, network test automation, and IP video operations and monetization, Vecima will focus on how operators can move next-generation access from planning into scalable deployment.
Leading the evolution to 50G-PON

Vecima’s fiber access demonstrations will focus on a key operator challenge: increasing PON capacity while preserving existing network investments. At TechExpo, Vecima will demonstrate live multi-PON migration, running 10G-EPON and 50G ITU PON simultaneously on the same optical line terminal (OLT) port and optical distribution network (ODN), showing how operators can move toward 50G-PON without replacing the fiber infrastructure they have already built.

This next-generation capability is designed to help operators modernize networks with low risk, investment protection, and operational flexibility. Vecima’s approach lets operators manage 10G-PON, XGS-PON, GPON, Combo PON, and 50G-PON through a single operational framework, supported by the Company’s Open Network Ecosystem (ONE™) and broad third-party ONU/ONT interoperability, so the move to multi-gigabit fiber does not require vendor lock-in.
“50G-PON is moving from roadmap discussion to practical deployment,” said
Ryan Nicometo, Chief Product Officer at Vecima

. “Our demonstration shows operators how they can add next-generation PON capacity on their own timelines, using existing fiber infrastructure and a migration path designed to reduce operational risk.”
Setting the pace in DOCSIS 4.0

Vecima’s next-generation access focus extends from fiber to cable, where its cloud-native DOCSIS platform is helping operators evolve HFC networks with an emphasis on scalability, flexibility, and operational simplicity. Entra® vCMTS, the Company’s fully containerized, cloud-native virtual CMTS, is emerging as one of the industry’s fastest-growing DOCSIS 4.0 platforms. A Canadian telecommunications leader, Videotron, selected Entra vCMTS, together with Vecima’s EN9000 GAP Node and ERM3 Remote PHY Devices, to support the evolution of its next-generation DOCSIS network and extend a decades-long partnership between the two companies. At TechExpo, attendees will see our vCMTS platform and multiple DOCSIS 3.1 and DOCSIS 4.0 nodes running live.
Vecima is a proud sponsor of the DOCSIS 4.0 Bootcamp on Monday, September 28, at SCTE TechExpo.
Introducing Entra Intelligence

As operators advance both 50G-PON and DOCSIS 4.0, the next challenge isn't only building higher-capacity networks, but operating them more intelligently. Entra Intelligence marks Vecima’s entry into AI-driven network operations, correlating data across the access network, from the physical layer to the subscriber edge, to give operators greater visibility, improved reliability, and simplified operations at the speed next-generation networks demand. Built to work across both cable and fiber access, Entra Intelligence combines real-time insights with an AI-assisted interface, turning reactive troubleshooting into proactive, data-informed network management.
“Entra Intelligence represents a shift in how broadband service providers will operate increasingly complex access networks,” said
Colin Howlett, Chief Technology Officer, Vecima Networks

. “As DOCSIS 4.0 and next-generation PON networks generate more data across more layers of the network, operators need intelligence that can correlate, prioritize, and act in real time. That is the role Entra Intelligence is built to play.”

Vecima will also highlight how Entra Intelligence extends across its broader access portfolio, complementing the Entra vCMTS, Entra EXS1610 All-PON platform, and Entra vPON Manager solution already deployed and in production at operators today.

Together, the demonstrations highlight Vecima’s integrated approach to next-generation access, bringing cable, fiber, automation, AI-driven operations, and video innovation together in one live TechExpo showcase.
“Operators are making decisions now about how to scale capacity, simplify operations, and prepare their networks for an AI-enabled future,” said
Clay McCreery, President and Chief Operating Officer, Vecima Networks

. “At SCTE TechExpo, Vecima is showing the technologies that make that future practical today: open, intelligent cable and fiber access platforms that help operators move faster, protect their investments, and deliver the broadband and video experiences their customers expect.”
Vecima speakers at TechExpo

Vecima experts will take the stage throughout SCTE TechExpo 2026, joining industry leaders and customers to explore the technologies shaping the future of broadband and video. Sessions will span DOCSIS 4.0, intelligent vCMTS operations, AI-native and autonomous networks, customer experience, and next-generation edge streaming.

The Exchange: A Tech Salon

Together, the sessions showcase Vecima’s leadership across broadband access, AI-driven network operations, and video delivery, as well as its role in helping define the future of intelligent, software-driven networks.
Visit Vecima Networks at SCTE TechExpo in Atlanta, September 29 – October 1, in Booth B362
About Vecima Networks

Vecima Networks Inc. (TSX: VCM) builds the intelligent infrastructure powering the next generation of connectivity. Through broadband access, content delivery, cloud-native software, automation, and AI-enabled solutions, Vecima helps service providers modernize cable and fiber networks, deliver exceptional broadband and video experiences, and operate more intelligent, efficient networks. As operators evolve toward AI-enabled, software-driven architectures, Vecima's platforms simplify operations, accelerate innovation, and enable the reliable, high-performance networks that connect homes, businesses, and communities around the world. Learn more at vecima.com.
